definitions.explanation: The meat of horses, eaten in Japan mainly raw as {馬刺|ばさ}し. Kumamoto and Nagano are the best-known producing areas.

examples.japanese: {馬肉|ばにく}を{食|た}べたことがない。
{熊本|くまもと}は{馬肉|ばにく}が{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Kumamoto is famous for horse meat.

examples.japanese: {馬肉|ばにく}は{脂肪|しぼう}が{少|すく}なく、たんぱく{質|しつ}が{多|おお}いと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Horse meat is said to be low in fat and high in protein.

notes:
From {馬|うま} (horse) + {肉|にく} (meat), read with the on'yomi ば.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {馬肉|ばにく}{料理|りょうり}: horse meat dishes
- {馬肉|ばにく}の{刺身|さしみ}: horse meat sashimi
- {新鮮|しんせん}な{馬肉|ばにく}: fresh horse meat

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {馬刺|ばさ}し: raw sliced horse meat — the usual way it is served, eaten with soy sauce, ginger, and garlic
- さくら{肉|にく}: "cherry meat" — an older euphemism for horse meat, from its pink color
